policy: No security-sensitive digest may rely on ambiguous packed encoding. abi.encodePacked (and bytes.concat/string.concat or off-chain solidityPacked fed into a hash) is allowed only when every operand is fixed-width or a compile-time constant literal (FIXED_WIDTH), when every variable-length operand carries an explicit length prefix (LENGTH_PREFIXED), or when an external standard fixes the byte layout (PROTOCOL_DEFINED). Inside the canonical V2 scope those are the only digest classes. SINGLE_DYNAMIC (exactly one variable-length operand, therefore one parse) is tolerated only in legacy, deprecated, or test code. Non-hashed uses must be NON_DIGEST, or DELIMITED_VALIDATED when fields are delimiter-joined and a guard rejects the delimiter. LEGACY_MIRROR is reserved for test fixtures that reproduce retired schemes. See docs/ENCODE_PACKED_POLICY.md.
